units.source_text: 大风骚扰了一昼夜，源氏公子虽然强自振奋，毕竟十分疲劳，不知不觉地睡着了。

en.t: The great storm had raged for a whole day and night, and although Prince Genji forced himself to keep his spirits up, he was utterly exhausted and fell asleep before he knew it.

units.source_text: 这住处实在太简陋，没有帐幕，公子只是靠在壁上打瞌睡。

en.t: The dwelling was truly too crude, with no curtains or screens, so the prince merely leaned against the wall and dozed.

units.source_text: 忽见已故的桐壶上皇站在眼前，神态全同生前一样，对公子说道：“你怎么住在这肮脏的地方？”

en.t: Suddenly he saw the late Retired Emperor Kiritsubo standing before him, looking exactly as he had in life, and saying to the prince, “How can you live in such a filthy place?”

units.source_text: 握住了他的手，拉他起来，接着又说：“你须依照住吉明神指引，火速开船，离去此浦！”

en.t: He took Genji by the hand, pulled him up, and then said, “You must follow the guidance of the Sumiyoshi deity, launch your boat at once, and leave this shore!”

units.source_text: 源氏公子不胜惊喜，奏道：“父皇呵，自从诀别慈颜以来，儿子身受了不知多少苦难！

en.t: Prince Genji was overwhelmed with astonished joy and said, “Father, since the day I parted from your gracious face, your son has endured countless hardships!
At this very moment I was about to cast myself into the sea!”

units.source_text: 桐壶上皇的阴魂答道：“岂有此理！

en.t: The spirit of the Retired Emperor Kiritsubo replied, “What nonsense!

units.source_text: 你此次受难，只是小小罪过的报应而已。

en.t: The suffering you are undergoing this time is only the retribution for a small offense.

units.source_text: 我在位时，并无何等大罪。

en.t: When I was on the throne, I committed no great sin of any kind.

units.source_text: 但无意之中，总难免犯下小过。

en.t: Yet without realizing it, one can hardly avoid committing minor faults.

units.source_text: 我为了赎罪，近来非常忙碌，无暇顾及阳世之事。

en.t: In order to atone for them, I have been extremely busy lately and have had no leisure to attend to affairs in the world of the living.

units.source_text: 但闻你近遭大难，我坐立不安，故特由冥府穿过大海，来到此浦，旅途非常疲劳。

en.t: But when I heard that you had recently met with a great calamity, I could not sit still, so I came specially from the underworld across the sea to this shore, and the journey has left me very weary.

units.source_text: 我还须乘此机会，到宫中一见皇上，有所叮嘱。

en.t: I must also take this opportunity to go to the palace, see the emperor, and give him certain instructions.
I am setting out for the capital immediately.”
